gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads friendly and unhurried, its wide, tall bowls left slightly unsealed like hooks. Dogica brings the muscle, a heavy display voice with wide tracking, and that gap between weight and ease is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads cleanly, with big round lowercase bowls and curves that leave clear gaps, under Dogica's heavy, widely tracked display shapes. Over a long passage it would feel plain and easygoing.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-arimo: Dogica opens with a heavy, commanding tone, its lowercase rising close to the capitals and every curve left slightly open. Arimo below is a plain sans with a tall mean line, giving the heading room to lead.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-armata: Chunky and wide-stepping, Dogica makes a loud first impression with lowercase that nearly matches its capitals. Armata follows with spacious gaps between characters, so making the heading a bit larger than the body lets the two keep their distance.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-athiti: Dogica's lowercase climbs almost to capital height, and its wide tracking gives every heading a stamped, commanding presence. Athiti keeps one stroke thickness throughout, with a visible gap in each s, so a long passage would read as relaxed and contemporary.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Heavy, wide and a bit blunt, Dogica takes the heading with lowercase that nearly matches its capitals. And Atkinson Hyperlegible, a sans-serif with clipped ascenders and wide-set terminals on s, would look lost if the heading were made small.

Approachable is the word for Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, whose open counters breathe into the white space around clipped ascenders. But Dogica, heavy and widely tracked above it, makes a longer passage feel like plain, spacious text under a loud sign.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-blinker: Blinker reads openly, its lines holding one thickness and its lowercase filling most of the height. Dogica's heavy, widely tracked heading, with far thicker strokes than the body, supplies the strongest quality here: a loud top and a quiet bottom.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads crisp and modern, its high-set x-height and generous c opening keeping each line tidy. Carrois Gothic would carry a long passage steadily, while Dogica above it supplies the heavy, widely tracked punch.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Dogica's most striking trait is its wide tracking, which stretches heavy letters out and leaves a clear opening at every curve.
